bodyHtml:
Oxford translation services

Get a quote
Watch our video

Why Oxford needs BeTranslated

Oxford is known worldwide for its university, but its economy now stretches well beyond teaching and research.

The University of Oxford contributes £750 million a year to the local economy and supports thousands of jobs across the city, from academic departments to Oxford University Press.

Oxford’s life sciences cluster, including research-led companies such as Oxford Nanopore, generates demand for translated patents, clinical documentation and investor material.

With around 18% of Oxford residents reporting a main language other than English, the city also needs clear multilingual communication for public services and personal documents.

If you are in Oxford, Reading, Cambridge, or London, BeTranslated brings over 20 years of experience to academic, scientific and business translation.

Translation services in Oxford

Legal translation services

Oxford’s university, publishing and life sciences sectors all depend on precise legal translation for licensing agreements, research contracts and intellectual property documents.

Our certified translators make sure every document is translated to a standard recognised by UK courts and regulatory bodies.

Life sciences and medical translation services

Oxford’s life sciences companies and healthcare institutions need accurate translations of clinical trial documents, patient information and laboratory reports.

BeTranslated provides medical translations handled by linguists who understand clinical and scientific terminology.

Academic and technical translation services

Oxford’s research community, from the sciences to the humanities, regularly needs technical translation services for research papers, grant applications and conference materials.

We translate into key global languages, including German, Spanish, French, and Italian, so Oxford’s research reaches a global audience.

Multilingual SEO and localisation services

For Oxford’s businesses, publishers and academic institutions, multilingual SEO and localisation helps readers find your content in their own language.

BeTranslated adapts websites, journals and digital content so they read naturally in each target market.

Interpretation services across Oxford

Oxford’s international student community and visiting researchers often need interpretation support for meetings, conferences and appointments.

We also offer British Sign Language (BSL) interpretation, supporting the estimated 25,000 people in the UK who use BSL as their primary language.

Why choose BeTranslated?

At BeTranslated, we combine expertise, precision, and a focus on client satisfaction.

  • Sector expertise: translators experienced in academic, legal, medical and life sciences work.
  • Cultural sensitivity: translations that read naturally for Oxford’s international academic and business community.
  • Fast turnaround: we meet tight deadlines without compromising quality.
  • Flexible services: from single documents to ongoing multilingual support.

BeTranslated understands Oxford’s dynamic economy and provides translation services to meet the unique needs of the region.

Frequently asked questions

Can you translate research papers and theses for Oxford students and academics?

Yes. We translate theses, research papers, grant applications and conference materials across a wide range of subjects.

Share any glossary or style guide your department uses, and we will follow it.

Do you handle translation for life sciences and pharmaceutical companies?

Yes. We translate clinical trial documents, patient information and regulatory material with translators who know the sector.

A second linguist can review the text if you want an extra check before submission.

Can you provide certified translations for university or visa applications?

Yes. We certify translations of transcripts, certificates and official documents so they are accepted by the relevant institution or authority.

Tell us who the translation is for, and we will advise on the certification you need.

Can you localise our website or journal for an international audience?

Yes. We translate and adapt pages, metadata and published content so it reads naturally in each market.

Send us the content and the languages you need, and we will advise on the best approach.

What do I need to book an interpreter in Oxford?

Tell us the languages, the date, the location and the subject.

We match an interpreter and confirm the details with you before anything is arranged.

Get started with BeTranslated

Ready to communicate clearly with Oxford’s academic, scientific and business community?

Get a free, no-obligation quote here
Email us at hello@betranslated.co.uk
Call us at (+44) 20 3026 9848

At BeTranslated, we are dedicated to providing high-quality, professional translation services that help Oxford’s institutions and businesses reach audiences at home and abroad.
